text:
riley-peopleops: Quick update: we're changing a few handbook sections (code of conduct examples + WFH etiquette) and pairing that with a new "Elective Micro-Track" of 20m refresher modules. Managers should enroll their directs by May 10. :megaphone:

hema-hr: The handbook patch will be staged as v2.2 in Confluence. We'll post the summary & diff there. Link coming in the doc channel.

owen-eng: Are the micro-modules required for promotions/perf calibration?

riley-peopleops: Not required for calibration, but completion will be visible in manager dashboards and is recommended as prep for growth conversations.

lia-manager: Can I assign different electives per role? Some ICs could skip the meeting etiquette one.

riley-peopleops: Yes — electives are taggable by role. Use the Enroll modal or the manager bulk CSV.

lms-notify: New LMS flow: enrollments -> auto-ack -> People Console sync. Reminder cadence: enroll, +7d, +14d.

owen-eng: How do we handle part-time contractors? We have a vendor on 20% who should see the WFH etiquette but not the compliance pieces.

contractor-bot: Contractors excluded by default. To request enrollment, open an HR ticket with contractor_email and business_justification.

hema-hr: Note on privacy: accommodations/exemptions go into HR-only tracker tab. Do not include medical details in public comments.

lia-manager: For bulk enroll, what's the CSV template name?

riley-peopleops: CSV template: peopleops_microtrack_bulk_template_v1.csv. Columns: employee_email, employee_id, elective_id, enrolled_by, enrolled_at. Upload in People Console -> Learning -> Bulk Enroll.

owen-eng: Will managers get export columns with timestamps? Need completed_at for 1:1 notes.

lms-notify: Exports include completed_at, enrollment_id, ack_url. Download path: People Console > Learning > Exports.

riley-peopleops: Timeline: announce today; manager RSVP + bulk uploads by May 1; final enrollments May 10; automated reminders May 11-25; dashboard sync in mid-May.

lia-manager: Thanks — I'll prep the CSV and ping if I hit validation errors.

hema-hr: We'll run a short FAQ drop-in next Tue 09:30 PDT for managers who want a walkthrough. RSVP in the calendar invite.
